g.text: U6: 3.3V is the candidate rating, not a voltage measurement. NC4/5 board ties unresolved.

g.desc: U6: 3.3V is the candidate rating, not a voltage measurement. NC4/5 board ties unresolved.

g.text: V063 joins R37/R39; its remote supply is unknown. Old supply/GND guesses withdrawn.

g.desc: V063 joins R37/R39; its remote supply is unknown. Old supply/GND guesses withdrawn.

g.text: U2 and U3 use multiple symbol units on this same sheet, including supply units.

g.desc: U2 and U3 use multiple symbol units on this same sheet, including supply units.

g.text: H_* = inferred inter-block net. Other net names do not imply measurement.

g.desc: H_* = inferred inter-block net. Other net names do not imply measurement.

g.text: H09: 3724A matches SIL3724A N/P MOSFET pair. Both units share one package.

g.desc: H09: 3724A matches SIL3724A N/P MOSFET pair. Both units share one package.

g.text: R3/R4 sensing candidate; R4 returns to RB3. C28 value estimated.

g.desc: R3/R4 sensing candidate; R4 returns to RB3. C28 value estimated.

g.text: See docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md for evidence, alternatives, and calculations.

g.desc: See docs/RECONSTRUCTION.md for evidence, alternatives, and calculations.

g.text: No capacitor value or rail voltage in this drawing was electrically measured.

g.desc: No capacitor value or rail voltage in this drawing was electrically measured.

g.text: PIR daughterboard internals are not yet traced; J3 represents its interface.

g.desc: PIR daughterboard internals are not yet traced; J3 represents its interface.

g.text: D4/D5 opposite vias join rear GND copper. D6 type and routes remain uncertain.

g.desc: D4/D5 opposite vias join rear GND copper. D6 type and routes remain uncertain.

g.text: H07: C14R inverter candidate. Q8 source rail inferred; C6 destination unresolved.

g.desc: H07: C14R inverter candidate. Q8 source rail inferred; C6 destination unresolved.

g.text: 150 original main-board catalog entries, including DNP footprints and named pads.

g.desc: 150 original main-board catalog entries, including DNP footprints and named pads.

g.text: D2: 4P unidentified; old BAV99 clamp ties withdrawn.

g.desc: D2: 4P unidentified; old BAV99 clamp ties withdrawn.

g.text: One sheet. Functional wiring is proposed; this is not a verified production circuit.

g.desc: One sheet. Functional wiring is proposed; this is not a verified production circuit.

g.text: DNP = unpopulated. An open pin means unresolved, not a certified no-connect.

g.desc: DNP = unpopulated. An open pin means unresolved, not a certified no-connect.

g.text: PIC GPIOs are intentionally unassigned where photographs cannot support a map.

g.desc: PIC GPIOs are intentionally unassigned where photographs cannot support a map.

g.text: H10-H12: working topology around photographed 120k feedback resistors. Filters, bias, and interstage routes inferred.

g.desc: H10-H12: working topology around photographed 120k feedback resistors. Filters, bias, and interstage routes inferred.

g.text: 29 original local visual fragments are retained; added connections are hypotheses.

g.desc: 29 original local visual fragments are retained; added connections are hypotheses.

g.text: U3 alternative: MCP6002-I/SN; same pin roles, electrical suitability to verify.

g.desc: U3 alternative: MCP6002-I/SN; same pin roles, electrical suitability to verify.

g.text: C42 / R47 / R46: DNP options, exact pads unresolved.

g.desc: C42 / R47 / R46: DNP options, exact pads unresolved.

g.text: H14-H15: C2N supports S-812C33AMC 3.3V LDO. C/R3 ground supported by resistance.

g.desc: H14-H15: C2N supports S-812C33AMC 3.3V LDO. C/R3 ground supported by resistance.

g.text: U5 alternative: DRV8212PDSGR. Different package/pins; redesign required.

g.desc: U5 alternative: DRV8212PDSGR. Different package/pins; redesign required.

g.text: U5 datasheet symbol: separate logic VCC and motor VDD; both ground pins retained.

g.desc: U5 datasheet symbol: separate logic VCC and motor VDD; both ground pins retained.

g.text: U1 datasheet symbol: S-1200B45 SOT-23-5. Pin 4 is internally open; option pads retained.

g.desc: U1 datasheet symbol: S-1200B45 SOT-23-5. Pin 4 is internally open; option pads retained.

g.text: H13: 2H devices are probably PNP BJTs (MMBTA55 family; PBSS5140T is an alternative). Capacitor values unknown.

g.desc: H13: 2H devices are probably PNP BJTs (MMBTA55 family; PBSS5140T is an alternative). Capacitor values unknown.

g.text: H06: S1 pairs and RC debounce inferred.

g.desc: H06: S1 pairs and RC debounce inferred.

g.text: H05: NPN interface candidate; bias destination unresolved.

g.desc: H05: NPN interface candidate; bias destination unresolved.

g.text: Library pin numbers are mapped to photo pads in evidence/pin_crosswalk.json.

g.desc: Library pin numbers are mapped to photo pads in evidence/pin_crosswalk.json.

g.text: Do not infer complete tuning topology from local connections. Transistor identity/orientation remains provisional.

g.desc: Do not infer complete tuning topology from local connections. Transistor identity/orientation remains provisional.

g.text: H01: likely S-1200B45 LDO. Nominal 4.5 V is a candidate, not a measured rail.

g.desc: H01: likely S-1200B45 LDO. Nominal 4.5 V is a candidate, not a measured rail.

g.text: Local three-capacitor junctions retained. Hidden links from these midpoints to antenna remain unknown.

g.desc: Local three-capacitor junctions retained. Hidden links from these midpoints to antenna remain unknown.

g.text: H04: MX512H typical supply/output topology. Motor A/B and MCU control assignments remain hypotheses.

g.desc: H04: MX512H typical supply/output topology. Motor A/B and MCU control assignments remain hypotheses.

g.text: Empty options: R1/C3 free ends join regulated VDD; R2/C4 free ends join GND.

g.desc: Empty options: R1/C3 free ends join regulated VDD; R2/C4 free ends join GND.

g.text: v0.9: user-reviewed GND returns replace previous antenna rails on this capacitor bank.

g.desc: v0.9: user-reviewed GND returns replace previous antenna rails on this capacitor bank.

g.text: C6: F-P 10 ohm, F-G 300 kohm suggests a supply-related node; exact path unresolved.

g.desc: C6: F-P 10 ohm, F-G 300 kohm suggests a supply-related node; exact path unresolved.

g.text: 8 GPIO pads open; RC1 joins VREF pad. RC4/RC5 reach V022/V023; onward routes unknown.

g.desc: 8 GPIO pads open; RC1 joins VREF pad. RC4/RC5 reach V022/V023; onward routes unknown.

g.text: ? on a part value or pin function means an estimate or candidate identity.

g.desc: ? on a part value or pin function means an estimate or candidate identity.
